	<ResortReportHeadline>Snowmaking overnight and sun incoming!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>What a great way to send off July. The sky is filled with stars, there's a big bright moon shining above which will soon be replaced by a big bright sun!</p><p>The current temp is -4.8 degrees, which was also the overnight low, and it should max out at a very pleasant 4 degrees. There's just a very slight breeze from the SSE which is expected to remain light for the day.</p><p>The snowmakers have had another really solid run and they're &nbsp;still pumping it out now. The open groomed terrain will be where it's at first up this morning on a dry mid-winter like surface perfect for getting your edges into. Off piste will be variable with only the sunniest of aspects perhaps softening as the day warms.</p><p>I was out on HV yesterday and the cover has greatly improved. Just take care and observe rope lines and signage before over committing. There's still obstacles out there and some runs have been upgraded in difficulty. The Extreme Area remains closed so please stay away.</p><p>In more good news the Road Runner Quad will be rolling from 7:30am for WRX First Tracks for some early corduroy laps. Bill's back in the seat tomorrow for what could be a spectacular Saturday!</p><p>Slap on the sunscreen and have a ripper day!</p><p>Cheers, Burner.</p></ResortReport>
